title: A short trip
text: Last month Mia took a short trip to a small city near the sea. She stayed in a nice hotel, and she ate local food every day. The restaurants were cheap, but the food was amazing. She visited an old building near the market and bought a small bag in a local shop. The price was good. She liked the place, but the city was crowded on Saturday. Her current plan is another trip in May.
